Functions.Original: static inline void        SC_PairClean( SC_Pair * d )               { d->rise = d->fall = 0;                 }
Functions.Draft: func SC_PairClean(d *SC_Pair) { d.rise = d.fall = 0;                 }

Functions.Name: SC_PairMax
Functions.Original: static inline float       SC_PairMax( SC_Pair * d )                 { return Abc_MaxFloat(d->rise, d->fall); }
Functions.Draft: func SC_PairMax(d *SC_Pair) float32 { return Abc_MaxFloat(d.rise, d.fall); }

Functions.Name: SC_PairMin
Functions.Original: static inline float       SC_PairMin( SC_Pair * d )                 { return Abc_MinFloat(d->rise, d->fall); }
Functions.Draft: func SC_PairMin(d *SC_Pair) float32 { return Abc_MinFloat(d.rise, d.fall); }

Functions.Name: SC_PairAve
Functions.Original: static inline float       SC_PairAve( SC_Pair * d )                 { return 0.5 * d->rise + 0.5 * d->fall;  }
Functions.Draft: func SC_PairAve(d *SC_Pair) float32 { return 0.5 * d.rise + 0.5 * d.fall;  }

Functions.Name: SC_PairDup
Functions.Original: static inline void        SC_PairDup( SC_Pair * d, SC_Pair * s )    { *d = *s;                               }
Functions.Draft: func SC_PairDup(d *SC_Pair, s *SC_Pair) { *d = *s;                               }

Functions.Name: SC_PairMove
Functions.Original: static inline void        SC_PairMove( SC_Pair * d, SC_Pair * s )   { *d = *s; s->rise = s->fall = 0;        }
Functions.Draft: func SC_PairMove(d *SC_Pair, s *SC_Pair) { *d = *s; s.rise = s.fall = 0;        }

Functions.Name: SC_PairAdd
Functions.Original: static inline void        SC_PairAdd( SC_Pair * d, SC_Pair * s )    { d->rise += s->rise; d->fall += s->fall;}
Functions.Draft: func SC_PairAdd(d *SC_Pair, s *SC_Pair) { d.rise += s.rise; d.fall += s.fall;}

Functions.Name: SC_PairEqual
Functions.Original: static inline int         SC_PairEqual( SC_Pair * d, SC_Pair * s )  { return d->rise == s->rise && d->fall == s->fall;                }
Functions.Draft: func SC_PairEqual(d *SC_Pair, s *SC_Pair) int32 { return d.rise == s.rise && d.fall == s.fall;                }

Functions.Name: SC_PairEqualE
Functions.Original: static inline int         SC_PairEqualE( SC_Pair * d, SC_Pair * s, float E )  { return d->rise - s->rise < E && s->rise - d->rise < E &&  d->fall - s->fall < E && s->fall - d->fall < E;    }
Functions.Draft: func SC_PairEqualE(d *SC_Pair, s *SC_Pair, E float32) int32 { return d.rise - s.rise < E && s.rise - d.rise < E &&  d.fall - s.fall < E && s.fall - d.fall < E;    }

Functions.Name: SC_CellPinCapAve
Functions.Original: static inline float       SC_CellPinCapAve( SC_Cell * p )           { int i; float c = 0; for (i = 0; i < p->n_inputs; i++) c += SC_CellPinCap(p, i); return c / Abc_MaxInt(1, p->n_inputs); }
